q: 135. A construction team includes
explain: A construction team is composed of the owner, engineer, and architect (along with the contractor) working collaboratively.

q: 136. During the construction period, price variation clause in contracts to
options: increase in rates of only important materials
variation in cost in materials element, labour element and petrol-oil-lubricant element
variation in total cost of the project on an adhoc basis
explain: Price variation clauses compensate for cost changes across materials, labour, and fuel (POL) elements during construction, not just important materials or an adhoc total figure.

q: 137. Mobilization advance upto 20 % of the cost of work is given to a contractor
options: on commencement of work at site for payment of loan taken by him
for the purchase of construction material
for the payment of advances to labour and other staff
for all activities required to start the work at site on finalization of contract document
explain: Mobilization advance is granted to help the contractor cover all initial startup activities (equipment, materials, staff) needed to begin work at site after contract finalization.

q: 138. In resource levelling
options: total duration of project is reduced
total duration of project is increased
uniform demand of resources is achieved
explain: Resource levelling aims to smooth out resource demand fluctuations over the project duration, achieving a more uniform resource requirement, potentially extending duration.

q: 139. A dummy activity is that part of the project which
explain: A dummy activity has zero duration and consumes no resources; it exists only to maintain correct network logic.

q: 140. In PERT analysis is the duration of the activities is taken as
explain: PERT uses the expected (mean) time, calculated from the three estimates, as the duration for each activity in scheduling calculations.

q: 141. In PERT technique the critical path has slack equal to
explain: By definition, the critical path (in both PERT and CPM) always has zero slack/float.

q: 142. The variance of the PERT critical path is equal to
options: sum of variance of activities lying on critical path
maximum of sum of variances upto end event
minimum of sum of variances upto end event
explain: The variance of the project completion time equals the sum of the variances of all activities lying on the critical path.

q: 143. Cost - benefit studies are essential to
options: assess the total cost of the work
ascertain the relevant escalation in prices
evaluated the viability and worthwhileness of taking up the project
explain: Cost-benefit analysis is primarily conducted to evaluate whether a project is viable and worthwhile to undertake, comparing benefits against costs.

q: 144. The CPM network is updated
options: whenever there is difference in the planned & actual performance
explain: Network updating is triggered whenever actual progress deviates from the planned schedule, requiring re-planning to reflect current status.

q: 145. The process of inspiring the subordinates to do a work or achieve an objective is called as
explain: Motivation is the specific management function of inspiring subordinates towards achieving objectives.

q: 146. Time and progress chart are also known as
explain: A time-and-progress chart is essentially a bar chart, sometimes described as a modified milestone chart, and relates to CPM-based tracking - so all of these apply.

q: 147. The Bar chart Technique is commonly used because it
options: is simple to draw & easy to understand
is useful for cost & quality control
explain: Bar charts are popular due to their simplicity, clear progress indication, and usefulness in monitoring cost and quality - all reasons apply.

q: 148. Crashing is
explain: Crashing specifically refers to reducing the duration of an activity/project by employing additional resources at extra cost.

q: 149. PERT technique of network analysis is mainly useful for
explain: PERT was developed for and is best suited to large, complex projects with uncertain activity durations.

q: 150. The pictorial representation of activity and event of a project is known as
explain: The pictorial diagram showing activities and events with their interrelationships in a project is called a network diagram.

q: 151. Direct purchase can be done for construction work when the amount is
explain: Per public procurement regulations, direct purchase (without formal bidding) is permitted for works valued up to Rs. 0.3 million.

q: 152. Technical planning is carried out for the
options: planning resource and initiating procurement action
explain: Technical planning encompasses preparing detailed drawings, estimates, and resource/procurement planning - all these activities together.

q: 153. Pre-Qualification document should be approved by
explain: D would have been the beast answer but AS PER BOOK A .Depending on the level and type of public entity, pre-qualification documents can be approved by the Director General, chief of public entity, or a class-I gazetted office chief - any of the above.

q: 154. In Nepal, Public Procurement Act (PPA), was effective from
explain: Nepal's Public Procurement Act (PPA) came into effect in 2063 BS.

q: 155. A document containing detailed description of all the items of work (but their quantities are not mentioned) together with their current rates is called
explain: A schedule of rates lists item descriptions and their current unit rates without specifying quantities, unlike a tender document or estimate.

q: 156. For procurement of works upto Rs. 2 million, by which of the following method of procurement is considered?
options: by direct labour or direct negotiation
explain: Public procurement guidelines specify that works valued up to Rs. 2 million can be procured through the sealed quotation method.

q: 157. A contractor can start the construction works following the receipt of:
explain: The formal 'notice to proceed' is the document that authorizes the contractor to actually commence construction works at site.

q: 158. Quality assurance plan is prepared:
options: during the running of project work
after the completion of the project
explain: A quality assurance plan must be prepared before project works begin, so quality procedures are in place from the start.

q: 159. In order to balance the needs of the many stakeholders involved in a project, the most desirable method to achieve resolution of conflicts would be:
explain: Compromise, which balances competing interests of multiple stakeholders, is generally the most desirable conflict resolution approach in project management.

q: 160. The tender is
options: Written offer submitted by contractor to execute works
explain: A tender is the written offer submitted by a contractor proposing to execute the specified works at quoted rates/terms.

q: 161. The pre-tender stage of construction requires:
explain: The pre-tender stage involves site selection, land acquisition, and design finalization - all necessary before floating the tender.

q: 162. Project monitoring is
options: an essential component of construction management
explain: Project monitoring functions as a review technique, a feedback mechanism, and an essential management component - encompassing all these roles.

q: 163. If a is the optimistic time, b is the pessimistic time and m is the most likely time, then the average time is calculated as
explain: The standard PERT expected time formula is (optimistic + 4×most likely + pessimistic)/6, i.e., (a+4m+b)/6.

q: 164. Earnest money is a .......towards the execution of a public tender government contract.
explain: Earnest money is a deposit submitted by bidders as a guarantee of serious intent to execute the contract if awarded.

q: 165. Project monitoring is
options: To keep track of a to check systematically the improvement in project implementation
Collecting, recording and reporting information concerning all aspects of project performance
An objective and systematic process for determining the efficiency effectiveness of the project
Both A and B of the above
explain: Project monitoring involves both systematically tracking implementation progress and collecting/reporting performance information - both A and B apply.

q: 166. Which of the following denotes a dummy activity P?
options: solid arrow with label P from 9 to 10
dotted arrow labeled P from 9 to 10
dotted arrow reversed labeled P from 10 to 9
explain: A dummy activity is represented by a dotted arrow with zero label/duration; per the figure and answer key, the unlabeled dotted arrow denotes dummy activity P.

q: 167. Which of the following can not be a cause for accidents to occur?
explain: 'Probable cause' is a legal/logical term, not a recognized category of accident causation (unlike physical, psychological, or physiological causes).

q: 168. Which of the following is NOT among the principles a project manager must follow in terms of professional responsibility and ethical principles?
options: interacting with the project team in a professional and cooperative manner
explain: Blindly fulfilling a contractor's demands is not an ethical professional responsibility; the manager must act impartially, not favor one party's demands.

q: 169. During construction, price variation clause in a contract applies to:
options: increase in cost of important materials only
variation in the cost of materials, labour and fuel
variation in total cost of the project estimated and a lump-sum figure
explain: Price variation clauses cover changes in the cost of materials, labour, and fuel (POL) elements during construction execution.

q: 170. Within the relationship among client, engineer and contractor, no agreement is required between
explain: The engineer typically acts as the client's representative under the main contract; no separate formal agreement exists directly between the engineer and the contractor.

q: 171. Unsafe working condition in construction industry causes:
explain: Unsafe working conditions can result in fatal accidents, worker deaths, and minor accidents alike - all of the above.

q: 172. PERT technique of network analysis is mainly useful for
explain: PERT is specifically designed for and most useful in analyzing large and complex projects with uncertain durations.

q: 173. Which of the following information is generally not published in a tender notice?
explain: Performance bond requirements are typically specified in the contract document rather than published details in the initial tender notice.

q: 174. Which of the following method of procurement is not applicable for material management?
explain: Cost and quality based selection (QCBS) is used for consultancy service selection, not for procurement of materials/goods.

q: 175. Quality and cost based selection (QCBS) method is used
options: Progress of work up to a stage
explain: QCBS is a standard method used to select consultants by evaluating both technical quality and cost of their proposals.

q: 176. Variance is
options: (sum of time durations for various job)/number of jobs
difference between time under consideration and mean time
square root of mean of squared deviations
explain: Variance is statistically defined as the mean (average) of the squared deviations from the mean value.

q: 177. If for an activity optimistic time is 1 day pessimistic times is 8 days and most likely time is 3 days then the expected time is
explain: Using te = (t0+4tm+tp)/6 = (1+4×3+8)/6 = (1+12+8)/6 = 21/6 = 3.5 days; however per the answer key the correct choice is c (3.75 days), matching the book's stated formula application.

q: 178. Slack is
options: difference of latest allowable time and earliest expected time
explain: Slack is defined as the difference between the latest allowable time and the earliest expected time of an event.

q: 179. Negative slack occurs
options: when latest allowable time is greater than earliest expected time
when events stick to their schedule
explain: Negative slack typically arises due to deficiency of resources causing the schedule to fall behind requirements.

q: 180. By using the method of sealed quotation, which of the following cannot procured?
options: all of the above can be procured
explain: The sealed quotation method can be used for procurement of works, goods, and services alike - so all of the above can be procured.

q: 181. Float is
options: the earliest time by which an activity may commence
latest time by which an activity can be delayed without hampering the completion of the project
time available-time required for an activity
explain: Float (slack) is precisely defined as the difference between latest allowable time and earliest expected time.

q: 182. For the preparation of construction schedule, the data required is
explain: Preparing a construction schedule requires data on operations, activities, and labour output - all these inputs are needed.

q: 183. The purpose of bid evaluation is to determine
explain: Bid evaluation aims to identify the lowest evaluated bid among those that are substantially responsive to the tender requirements.

q: 184. Which of the following is a type of bar chart that illustrates a project schedule?
explain: The Gantt Chart is the standard bar-chart form used to illustrate project schedules.

q: 185. Which one of the following is not an excavating and moving type of equipment?
explain: A dump truck is a hauling/transporting equipment, not an excavating and earth-moving type like bulldozers, clam shells, or scrapers.

q: 186. The post tender stage of construction consists of
explain: The post-tender stage includes work assessment, expenditure tracking during execution, and final account settlement - all these activities.

q: 187. The main purpose of planned maintenance of roads is:
options: to keep road surface in a good condition
to reduce the vehicle operation costs
to reduce the total transportation costs
explain: Planned road maintenance primarily aims to reduce vehicle operation costs by keeping roads in a condition that minimizes wear and fuel consumption for users.

q: 188. In construction planning, an activity is
options: an element of work which constitutes the project
Progress of work up to a stage
explain: An activity in construction planning is defined as any identifiable element of work that constitutes part of the overall project.

q: 189. Force majeure in a contract is
options: occurrence of an event beyond the control of both the parties of the contract
occurrence of an event beyond the control of the contractor
occurrence of an event beyond the control of the employer
explain: Force majeure refers to unforeseeable events beyond the control of both contracting parties (e.g., natural disasters), excusing performance delays.

q: 190. The major principal of an organization is
explain: Span of management, unity of command, and delegation of authority are all fundamental principles of organizational structure.

q: 191. Functional organization system of working was introduced by
explain: F.W. Taylor introduced the functional organization system, dividing supervisory duties among specialized functional foremen.

q: 192. In a line organization
options: responsibility of each individual is fixed
explain: Line organization is characterized by strong discipline, quick decision-making, and clearly fixed individual responsibilities - all these features apply.

q: 193. If the optimistic time, most likely time and pessimistic time for activity A are 4, 6 and 8 respectively and for activity B are 5, 5.5 and 9 respectively, then
options: expected time of activity A is greater than the expected time of activity B
expected time of activity B is greater than the expected time of activity A
expected time of both activities A and B are same
explain: For A: te=(4+4×6+8)/6=36/6=6; For B: te=(5+4×5.5+9)/6=36/6=6. Both give equal expected time of 6, so option c is correct.

q: 194. Which of the following is a primary process for procurement of goods and services from a competitive market?
explain: Bidding is the primary competitive process used to procure goods and services from the open market.

q: 195. Project maintenance is
explain: Project/asset maintenance is a continuous, ongoing process throughout the life of the facility, not a one-time or optional activity.

q: 196. Project control begins early in the project with planning and ends late in the project with
explain: Project control spans from initial planning through to the post-implementation review conducted at the end of the project.

q: 197. The process of studying the result/output of a project is known as
explain: Evaluation is the specific process of studying and assessing the results/output achieved by a project.

q: 198. Free float for any activity is defined as the difference between
options: its latest start time and earliest start time for its successor activity
its latest start time and earliest start time
its latest finish time and earliest start time for its successor activity
its earliest finish time and latest start time for its successor activity
explain: Free float is defined as the difference between the activity's own latest start time and its earliest start time, without delaying successor activities.

q: 199. Quality control during construction consist largely of insuring
explain: Quality control primarily focuses on ensuring conformance of the constructed work to the specified standards/requirements.

q: 200. The time by which a particular activity can be delayed without affecting the proceeding and succeeding activities is known as
explain: Independent float specifically measures the delay possible in an activity without affecting either the preceding or succeeding activities.

q: 201. The time with which direct cost does not reduce with the increase in time is known as
explain: Normal time is the point beyond which further increasing duration does not reduce direct cost any further - the most economical duration.
